rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
The assessment of the state of a requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ancestorOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is an ancestor of each `to` Element.
Provide context for a relationship that occurs in the lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityThreatModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the [security threat model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Threat_model) for the package.
Specifies a vulnerability and its associated information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: retired
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is no longer active for a specific use.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.
A collection of SPDX Elements describing a single package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eori
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/customs/customs-procedures-import-and-export/customs-operations/economic-operators-registration-and-identification-number-eori_en) is a unique identifier for businesses undertaking customs operations across European Union customs territory, such as import, export, and transit. It consists of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code followed by a national identifier of up to 15 alphanumeric characters (e.g., `PL1234567890ABCDE`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 5280](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc5280/). The primary media type shall be `application/pkix-cert`. The legacy media types `application/x-x509-ca-cert` and `application/x-x509-user-cert` may be used for backward compatibility, but shall not be used in new implementations. NOTE — RFC 5280 supersedes earlier X.509 profiles, including RFC 1422. Existing references based on RFC 1422 remain valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship is directionless).
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.
Temporary endeavor with a beginning and an end and that must be used to create a unique product, service or result.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: adler32
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Adler-32 checksum is part of the widely used zlib compression library as defined in [RFC 1950](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1950/) Section 2.3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dataset
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Dataset profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization and clients. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need-to-know basis.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).
This is the state of an affected Element at a specific moment in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and an email registration is required before accessing the dataset, although without an affirmative acceptance of terms.
A distinct article or unit related to Software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.
Specifies the type of an annotation.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
Reproduction is the biological process by which organisms generate new individuals of the same species.
A distinct article or unit within the domain.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [RFC 3874](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3874/).
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.

givenRole is a property that specifies the role being assigned in a RoleRelationship. It links the relationship to an instance of the Role class, defining the function, responsibility, or position that the source element confers upon the target element.
A Package that contains a dataset.
A code that identifies a county.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.
Categories of presence or absence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.

rdf:Description.sh:message: Class is known to not derive from Extension and cannot be used

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build system used to create or publish the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record the Package-URL for a software Package.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been evaluated on the `to` Element(s).
A location where a package or an item will be dropped off or delivered.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.
Specifies the type of the external identifier.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/endTime](../../Core/Properties/endTime.md) instead.
Property that describes the time at which a build stops.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` SpdxDocument can be found in a serialized form in each `to` Artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.
This class represents the process involved in manufacturing products.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.
Agent represents anything with the potential to act on a system.
Authorization specifies the permissions, rights, privileges, or benefits granted to a Role, defining what the role is authorized to access, perform, or receive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.
A prescribed change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vatNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Value Added Tax (VAT) number, or Goods and Services Tax (GST) number, is an identifier assigned by tax authorities that uniquely identifies a business within a specific national border or tax jurisdiction for the collection and tracking of VAT/GST.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Community wide. The dataset shall be shared only within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.
Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's build phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element.
An action of crossing a boundary is defined in this class.
A key with an associated value.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.
Location is used to define the location, address or coordinates of a place.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.
Abstract class for the portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a license.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
Enumeration of valid profile identifiers.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
Specifies the CVSS vector string for a vulnerability.
Information about different steps of the training process.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.
Sponsor of the project.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).
A key used in a generic key-value pair.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.
Provides an EPSS assessment for a vulnerability.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dynamicAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a dynamic analysis report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
Dimensions generally refer to measurable extents or attributes that define the size, shape, or scale of an object, system, or concept.
A mathematically calculated representation of a grouping of data.

It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of an additionalInformation key and/or its values, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.
A location of the organization's headquarters.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
A software agent.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/CreateProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md4
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD4 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1186](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1186/).
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: descendantOf
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a descendant of each `to` Element.

Protocols which support authentication.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).
Provides a detailed description of the Element.
Software provided as a service over a network.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement is considered a draft state and may be modified before being submitted for review.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.
Class that describes a build instance of software/artifacts.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.
The element that has its responsibility changed.
Methods that can be used to explain the results from the AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata `to`).
The measure of mass refers to the quantity of matter in an object or substance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Extension/Extension is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.
Specifies the outcome of an evaluation or verification process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: email
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Email address, as defined in [RFC 3696](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3696/) Section 3.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).
Version string for an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: All other simulation types.
The number that identifies a PO box. A PO box is a box in a post office or other postal service location assigned to an organization where postal items may be kept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b256
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 256, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL (PURL), as defined in [ECMA-427](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-427/).

The type of external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
